messages:
emily: Heads-up 8: bank opened chargeback CH-1973509999 for ZephyrAnalytics transaction tx_zA1b2 ($4,500.00). Cardholder (PineGrid) claims "never authorized recurring charge" 12/issue type: subscription dispute. Put payout on hold.
billing-bot: Automated: Chargeback CH-1973509999 created b7 merchant: ZephyrAnalytics (mch_918) b7 hold applied to payout b7 evidence requested from merchant contact b7 response deadline: 3 days
raj: Can you paste the txn meta? auth_time, acquirer_ref, card_last4, plan id?
emily: Copying from ledger 
```
transaction_id: tx_zA1b2
amount: 4500.00
currency: USD
auth_time: 2026-01-27T09:43:12Z
acquirer_ref: ACQ-8f3e1
card_last4: 9876
merchant_id: mch_918
product_plan: enterprise-annual-2026
recurring: true
```
olivia: Merchant says this was an annual enterprise invoice they invoiced vs charged on card on file after signed agreement. Do they have PO or signed quote?
emily: They uploaded invoice + signed quote to the support ticket: https://redwood-internal/s3/evidence/mch_918/tx_zA1b2/packet.zip. Also pulled API usage logs and a screenshot of the admin console showing license active.
legal-bot: Note: signed quote alone + access logs can be acceptable, but bank likes explicit customer acceptance (signed PO or acceptance email). If merchant only has a signed quote that references terms of service, include the TOS acceptance event.
raj: Can we get IPs / admin login timestamps to correlate? Also need billing email thread showing authorization to bill.
olivia: Zephyr attached usage.csv with first activity 2026-01-28T04:21:03Z from IP 203.0.113.45 and admin login at 2026-01-27T09:40:08Z (same timezone). They also have an email thread where PineGrid infra lead (j.dalton@pinegrid.com) replies "confirmed, proceed" to the quote on 2026-01-26. Uploaded to ticket.
emily: Great, add that to the packet. Also note merchant mentions they created the customer account through a sales rep who completed KYC with a PO number in our sales CRM (SFDC id: SF-5531).
legal-bot: Please export the SFDC PO record and redacted KYC notes for submission. Ensure we redact any sensitive personal info before attaching.
raj: We'll also check that the auth time and invoice charge timestamp line up (no delayed settlement oddities). If the cardholder claims "unauthorized", card network often looks for proof of customer initiation and usage.
olivia: I'll assemble representment packet: invoice.pdf, signed_quote.pdf, email_acceptance.eml, usage.csv, admin_screenshot.png, sfdc_po_export.csv, kyc_redacted.txt. Plan to submit to acquirer within 48 hours.
emily: Merchant is asking for fast-track 1; reserve is linked to this merchant and they want release asap. Any chance to do partial release?
legal-bot: Partial release requires manual sign-off from risk team. We can propose a temporary partial payment if evidence is strong, but ops needs to approve. I'll queue for review.
raj: Also flag for ops: acquirer returned MCC 5815 (grocery) while merchant category should be 5734 (computer software). Not a blocker for representment but curious. Possible gateway mapping issue. Could cause disputes to route incorrectly.
emily: Noted, will open a mapping ticket with payments-ops.
olivia: Evidence uploaded to dispute CH-1973509999 by olivia: invoice.pdf, signed_quote.pdf, email_acceptance.eml, usage.csv, admin_screenshot.png, sfdc_po_export.csv, kyc_redacted.txt b7 status: evidence_ready_for_review
raj: I'll validate timestamps and run the geolocation check on the IPs. ETA 6 hours.
legal-bot: Deadline reminder: representment window closes in 72 hours from chargeback creation. If anything missing, escalate now.
emily: Thanks team. I'll notify Zephyr about timelines and next steps. Ping me if ops approves any partial release. :thumbsup:
